name: aidlc-o00ontcong
description: A shared AI development workspace for VS Code. Keep project context, decisions, status, focused tasks, workflow pipelines, review, and verification in one visible place.

commands.title: Ask AIDLC (what it does / how to set up)
Generate Pipeline from Recipe (by task type)
Uninstall Workflow Globals (run before removing extension)
Migrate Tasks to Current Workspace Pipelines
Load iOS Demo Project (TodoKit — parent + child pipeline)
Open AIDLC Monitor (Token Usage + Insights + Agents)

aidlc.autopilot.enabled.markdownDescription: 🚧 **Task pre-planning experiment.** When enabled, New Task collects project context and generates a recommended plan (`context.json` + `autopilot-plan.md`) before its selected pipeline runs. Off by default.

aidlc.tokenMonitor.enabled.description: Show a status bar item with today/this-month Claude token spend, parsed from ~/.claude/projects logs.

aidlc.tokenMonitor.refreshSeconds.description: How often to re-scan ~/.claude/projects for new usage records (seconds, minimum 15).

aidlc.tokenMonitor.suggestionWindowDays.description: Window the cost-suggestion engine scans (in days). Older logs are skipped — they don't reflect current habits.

aidlc.monitor.enabled.description: Show a status bar item that polls the agents-observe server and opens the unified Monitor panel (Token Usage + Agents). Has no effect when agents-observe isn't running.

aidlc.monitor.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to poll the agents-observe server (GET /api/status) for the status bar and Monitor panel (seconds). Polling pauses while the window is unfocused.

aidlc.astGraph.enabled.description: Auto-download the ast-graph CLI, scan the workspace in the background, and register it as a Claude MCP server so Claude can read structural code context cheaply.

aidlc.astGraph.autoRescanDebounceSeconds.description: Debounce window for incremental rescans after source files change (seconds).

aidlc.mcp.listTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout (seconds) for `claude mcp list` in the MCP Servers panel. Claude health-checks every configured server, so raise this if you have many remote/unauthenticated servers and see a timeout.

aidlc.workspace.epicsDirectory.description: Relative path (from the project root) where task workspaces are stored. Changing this updates `state.root` in workspace.yaml. The Tasks view and New Task wizard use this directory immediately.

aidlc.displayLanguage.description: Language for AIDLC interface labels and AI-authored Markdown artifacts. Auto follows VS Code's display language.

aidlc.jira.site.description: Jira Cloud site, e.g. acme.atlassian.net. The API token is stored in VS Code SecretStorage, never here.

aidlc.jira.email.description: Email of the Atlassian account used for Jira API calls.

aidlc.jira.projectKey.description: Optional Jira project key used to find the board (e.g. ACME).

aidlc.jira.boardId.description: Scrum board id to read sprints from. 0 = pick the first board the account can see.

aidlc.jira.jql.description: Optional JQL override for the Sprint tab. When set it replaces the default "assignee = currentUser() AND sprint IN openSprints()" query entirely.

aidlc.jira.refreshMinutes.description: Minutes before cached sprint data is refetched. 0 disables auto-refresh (manual Refresh only).

aidlc.jira.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Per-request timeout for Jira and Confluence API calls.

aidlc.jira.transitions.enabled.description: Push AIDLC pipeline progress back to Jira as status transitions. Off by default — this writes to your team's board.

aidlc.jira.transitions.onTaskCreated.description: Jira status to move a ticket to when an AIDLC task is created from it. Empty = do nothing.

aidlc.jira.transitions.onReview.description: Jira status to move a ticket to when the run reaches its first review gate. Empty = do nothing.

aidlc.jira.transitions.onRunCompleted.description: Jira status to move a ticket to when the run completes. Empty = do nothing. A transition into a Done category always asks for confirmation.

aidlc.jira.transitions.confirm.description: Ask before each Jira status transition.

aidlc.jira.subtasks.enabled.description: Allow creating Jira subtasks from the template. Off by default — this writes to your team's board.

aidlc.jira.subtasks.templatePath.description: Path (relative to the workspace root) of the subtask template YAML.

aidlc.jira.subtasks.confluencePageUrl.description: Confluence page the subtask template is imported from, for re-import.

aidlc.jira.subtasks.issueTypeName.description: Subtask issue type name. "auto" resolves it from the project (the type flagged subtask).

aidlc.jira.subtasks.assignToMe.description: Assign created subtasks to the authenticated account.

aidlc.jira.transitions.onRunFailed.description: Jira status to move a ticket to when the run fails. Empty = do nothing (the default: a failed run is usually still in progress).

walkthroughs.title: Get started with AIDLC
walkthroughs.description: Drive Claude through any pipeline declared in workspace.yaml — visually, from the editor.

steps.title: Welcome to AIDLC
steps.description:
AIDLC turns a single `workspace.yaml` into a runnable pipeline of Claude agents — edit it visually, run epics step-by-step, approve or reject each handoff.

The fastest way to feel it is to load the demo project in the next step.

steps.title: Load the demo project
steps.description:
One click scaffolds a full pipeline plus 6 sample epics into your current folder — no YAML to write.
[Load Demo Project](command:aidlc.loadDemoProject)

steps.title: Open the Workspace Builder
steps.description:
Visual editor for your agents, skills, and pipelines. Add an agent, swap its model, edit a skill inline.
[Open Workspace Builder](command:aidlc.openBuilder)

steps.title: Run your first task
steps.description:
Pick a sample task and watch the provider work through the pipeline. Approve, reject, or rerun any step.
[Open Tasks](command:aidlc.openEpicsList) · [New Task](command:aidlc.startEpic)

steps.title: Drive runs from the terminal
steps.description:
One-click zsh terminal in the bottom panel with the Claude CLI auto-launched. Use slash commands or run `aidlc` directly.
[Open Claude CLI Terminal](command:aidlc.openClaudeTerminal)

steps.title: Build your own workspace
steps.description:
Scaffold a fresh `.aidlc/workspace.yaml`, add custom skills/agents/pipelines, save the result as a reusable template.
[Init Sample Workspace](command:aidlc.initWorkspace) · [Add Skill](command:aidlc.addSkill) · [Add Agent](command:aidlc.addAgent) · [Save as Template](command:aidlc.savePreset)

scripts.copy:annotron: rm -rf vendor && mkdir -p vendor && cp -R ../../vendor/annotron vendor/annotron
scripts.compile: pnpm copy:templates && pnpm copy:tools && pnpm copy:annotron && tsc -p ./ && vite build
scripts.watch: trap 'kill 0' SIGINT EXIT; pnpm watch:tsc & pnpm watch:webviews & wait
scripts.package: pnpm --filter @aidlc/core build && pnpm copy:templates && pnpm copy:tools && pnpm copy:annotron && pnpm typecheck && pnpm clean:out && pnpm bundle:webviews && pnpm bundle:prod && vsce package --no-dependencies
